subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
By the county each hospital sits in, as CMS records it.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did At St. Joseph have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other Mosaic Life Care hospital reports more; Harrison County Community Hospital is next at 201. About 7.8 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Harrison County Community Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; At St. Joseph has the most, 2,590. About 13.4 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Mosaic Medical Center Albany have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; At St. Joseph has the most, 2,590. About 4.9 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Mosaic Life Care's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: What percent of At St. Joseph's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; Harrison County Community Hospital runs highest, 73 percent. Traditional Medicare was 35 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 22 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Harrison County Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Mosaic Life Care hospital runs higher; Mosaic Medical Center Albany is next at 66 percent. Traditional Medicare was 63 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 10 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Mosaic Medical Center Albany's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; Harrison County Community Hospital runs highest, 73 percent. Traditional Medicare was 61 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 4 percent.

questions.q: What percent of At St. Joseph's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other Mosaic Life Care hospital runs higher; Harrison County Community Hospital is next at 3 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 14 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 7 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Harrison County Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; At St. Joseph runs highest, 21 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 1 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Mosaic Medical Center Albany's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; At St. Joseph runs highest, 21 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 1 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Mosaic Life Care's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Mosaic Life Care's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at At St. Joseph in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the shortest of 3 Mosaic Life Care hospitals; Harrison County Community Hospital ran longest, 8.1 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Mosaic Life Care run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Missouri. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many of Mosaic Life Care's hospitals are critical access hospitals?
questions.why: They are Harrison County Community Hospital and Mosaic Medical Center Albany.

questions.q: How many of Mosaic Life Care's hospitals are outside a metropolitan area?
questions.why: They are Harrison County Community Hospital and Mosaic Medical Center Albany.
